newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Trading in shares of Daesung Ind, affiliate halted.
newsitem.headline: Trading in shares of Daesung Ind, affiliate halted.

text.p: The Korea Stock Exchange said on Monday it has suspended trading in shares of Daesung Industrial Co and its affiliate Daesung Resources Co for the morning session after Daesung Industrial announced a plan to absorb its affiliate.

Daesung Industrial said in a statement it has decided to absorb Daesung Resources on August 1. The plan is subject to approval at an extraordinary shareholders' meeting of the two companies on May 28.
Daesung Industrial shares last traded at 49,900 won per share on Saturday and Daesung Resources at 84,700 won.
